title: IsamasRed: A Public Dataset Tracking Reddit Discussions on Israel-Hamas Conflict
benchmark_measurement: Analysis of online Reddit discourse related to religious/ethnic conflicts, specifically tracking discussions on antisemitism, Islamophobia, and Zionism, and identifying activity within religious-affiliated subreddits (e.g., r/islam, r/Judaism).
findings: Discussions related to 'Zionism and antisemitism' were more dominant in volume than those concerning 'Free Palestine and Islamophobia' within the collected Reddit dataset. Additionally, religious-affiliated subreddits like r/islam and r/Judaism were identified as forums with heightened activity levels regarding the conflict.
